transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

I assure you, I had no intention of letting the rehearsals slip. I apologize for any inconvenience caused. Rest assured, we will get this sorted out quickly. I will make sure that the singers are prepared, the missing parts are copied, and the stage directions are corrected. The premiere will proceed as planned. Thank you for your understanding, and please forgive the current situation. We will do better next time. Thank you again, Your Imperial Majesty.
